title: Concept: Refresh header redirects to an absolute URL
description: A response navigates through the Refresh header. Meta-refresh style navigation is easy to build from a request parameter, and because it never touches the Location header it slips past redirect allowlists, WAF rules and open-redirect scanners that only inspect Location.
applicability: HTTP responses that carry a Refresh header.
risk: User redirected to an arbitrary destination; LOW severity.
